Перейдите в каталог `~/pool-define`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-pools-pool-define}
#### Persistent definition lab-pool

Выполните:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-define-as lab-pool dir --target /tmp/libvirt-lab-pool
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-list --all > pool-list-all.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system pool-info lab-pool > pool-info-lab-pool.txt
```
:::
